row: The Physical Therapy and Wellness Channel

Welcome to The Physical Therapy and Wellness Channel! Are you struggling with back pain? Have you been wondering if Pilates classes could work for you? Do you want to know more about physical therapy? Then you are in the right place! Covering a wide range of topics about your health and wellness, this channel is designed to educate and inspire. Our videos focus on cost breakdowns, industry comparisons, and expert advise from the licensed physical therapists who work in our clinics. 

Founded in 1999, EW Motion Therapy is a physical therapy and wellness company based in the greater Birmingham area of Alabama. With years of experience under our belts, we feel confident guiding you through any issues you may have concerning physical therapy, personal training, pre- and post-operative care, fall prevention, dry needling, Pilates, women’s health, sports injury recovery, and more.

Subscribe and check out the links below to get back on track and start moving like yourself again!
